name: Qotusu
blurb: Continents of kingdoms and dwarf-holds, three underdark strata and sky isles. Two centuries of wars, plagues and fallen dynasties. Three linked planets (Qotusu, Khanufemoqe, Were) joined by rifts.

name: Mangrar
blurb: An archipelago of megacorps, arcologies and neon undercities. Gangers on the maglev, data vaults below. Three linked planets (Mangrar, Lobe, Shode) joined by rifts.

name: Misuchu
blurb: One great continent of gene-clans and hive cities, mycelial warrens beneath, living airships above. Three linked planets (Misuchu, Modu, Bo'sume) joined by rifts.

name: Zotbozdiv
blurb: Scavenger towns and raider clans over irradiated ruins, with vault-bunkers and metro lines below and wrecks fallen from the sky. Three linked planets (Zotbozdiv, Dekoru, Mufoka) joined by rifts.

name: Sirati
blurb: A golden age long collapsed: demigod lords, plague wards and hunters, catacombs below and a drowned gilded city under the sea. Three linked planets (Sirati, Pongpen, Tlotri) joined by rifts.
